text:
jamie: Need a new compact GPU node pool in uk-south for edge inference (low-latency). Product wants ~20 concurrent small-model sessions with p95 <100ms. Our current GPU quota in uk-south is exhausted — want ideas on sizing and fallbacks.

priya: For low latency single-GPU instances are better than multi-GPU. a10g looks like a good fit. What are the expected qps and seq lengths?

jamie: qps ~25 sustained, short seqs (<=128). Need autoscale to 0 overnight. Proposal: baseline reserved nodes + burst spot pool. Taint baseline nodes with `gpu=edge:NoSchedule` and label for AZ affinity.

ashley: Taint + labels makes sense. uk-south quotas are tight though — we'll need quota requests. Also prefer spreading across AZs to avoid AZ-level outages. Avoid >50% spot for baseline since preempts will spike latency. :eyes: 

mike: Mixed pool approach sounds good: baseline reserved a10g (4 nodes) and burst spot t4/a10g for scale to 12. Use CA with `balanced-similar-node-groups` and pod priority classes so critical pods win. Add PDBs for model service.

jamie: Proposed autoscaler settings: baseline pool min=4,max=8; burst pool min=0,max=12; scaleDownUnneededTime=10m; expander=least-waste. We'll set critical pods with priority=100000 and fallback pods lower.

nate: Heads up — NAT / egress IPs in uk-south are limited. Model downloads and metrics scrape could bottleneck. Either request more NAT IPs or use per-AZ NAT gateways. Opened INFRA-789 for NAT capacity.

infra-bot: created cloud-quota-request#832 for a10g GPUs in uk-south (status: pending).

priya: Also add a small warmup KV cache job so cold-starts are less painful. Pre-warm container can reduce first-token latency. Could run a cron job when nodes come up.

ashley: Quick cost sanity check: baseline 4 x a10g reserved ~ $X/day (est), burst spot t4 ~ $Y/day — mixed is cheaper than all-reserved and safer than all-spot. Need final numbers for finance.

mike: For autoscaler, enable `scaleDownUnneededTime=10m`, `scaleDownUnreadyTime=20m`, and set expander to `least-waste`. Also enable `--balance-similar-node-groups` so CA evens out usage. Use priority classes to prevent eviction of critical inference pods.

jamie: Draft node-pool create (will convert to cloud CLI for our provider):

```
# example (adapt to provider)
nodepool create uk-south-edge-gpu \ 
  --cluster=prod-uk \ 
  --machine-type=n1-standard-16 \ 
  --accelerator type=a10g,count=1 \ 
  --min-nodes=4 --max-nodes=8 \ 
  --node-taints=gpu=edge:NoSchedule \ 
  --labels=pool=edge-gpu,zone=uk-south-a
```

jamie: I'll open a PR with k8s manifests (nodeSelector, tolerations, PriorityClass, PDB, HorizontalPodAutoscaler hints) and a rollout plan (canary to 10%).

nate: Also link INFRA-789 + cloud-quota-request#832 in the PR and ping cloud support if it stalls. If quota slow, fallback plan is cross-region routing to europe-west for a short term.

ashley: I'll prepare the quota escalation and a brief cost delta slide. :thumbsup:

jamie: Thanks — I'll follow up with PR and schedule a short sync if cloud ops needs manual sign-off. Planning canary window 48h, monitor p95, preemptions, egress errors.

mike: One more: ensure metrics broken down by node pool (tokens/sec, queue_time_ms, node_preemptions) and alert if queue_time > 50ms for 5m.

jamie: Good call — will add dashboards and alert rules to the PR.

priya: FYI create small warmup job manifest in the same PR.

jamie: Opening ticket TKT-3456 to track work (PR + quota + cost). Will update thread when quota clears.

ashley: :rocket:
